items: 【Four-Layer Trapezoidal Liquor Display Shelf】Our floor wine rack is designed with 4 tiers trapezoidal liquor bottle display rack with horizontal storage layout for easy access. It can store wine bottles, whiskey, alcohol and more. It can better display your wine collection. Each shelf has iron fence front and back to prevent wine bottles from falling. In addition, our floor free standing wine rack can meet your storage needs for a large number of liquor.

【Stepped Design】 Our freestanding floor standing liquor cabinet features a stepped design that does not block each other when storing wine bottles, allowing each bottle to be displayed wonderfully. It not only meets your storage needs, but also serves as a wine storage organizer shelf. It is suitable to be placed in the corner or against the wall, or next to the bar to fulfill your daily needs and entertain your friends.

【Multiple Storage Options】 Our 4-tier liquor stand floor is not only suitable for wine bar, but can also be placed in kitchens, living room, coffee bars. This sturdy liquor bottle display rack can hold whiskey, wine, syrups, spice jars, salad dressings, olive oil and other bottles. The wood construction is both beautiful and functional!

【Vintage & Practical】 The wine bottle holder has two different storage options, horizontal and vertical, which can be used to organize liquor bottles. Vintage style wine storage racks with assorted liquor bottles make your room more ambient. The floor wine rack stand as room decorations are not only beautiful, but also neatly store liquor bottles and make your room more organized. Our alcohol rack has a vintage tabletop texture that makes your storage space more stylish!

【Sturdy & Durable】 Our wine rack cabinet is very sturdy and durable! The wine bottle holder is made of sturdy MDF and iron, which is strong enough to carry heavy loads. The wine bottle storage is designed with four adjustable feet to make the floor wine rack stand placement more stable. If you have any questions, please feel at ease to contact us for a friendly 24-hour service!
